title: Search select input field
description: One choice among options searched rather than all given: the field's own (`options`) and those a source answers for what is typed (`optionsUrl`, asked with `q`, answering words or `{ value, label }`). The value is a text, sent as it is; the option chosen is shown by its label (`valueLabel`, else the option of `options` holding it, else asked of the source). Whether the value is one the application accepts is the application's to check: the field does not hold every option.
